# 01_locateanything_dinotxt: LocateAnything3D detection check, every scene

*Generated by `summarize_locateanything.py` from each scene's `bench/locateanything_detect.json`; nothing is entered by hand.*

LocateAnything3D outputs **2D boxes, not instance masks**, so this measures localisation and speed only. It cannot drive POGS as the detector without a box-to-mask step. IoU is against the box around the ground-truth object mask. Sampling settings are the model card's (temperature 0.7, top_p 0.9, repetition penalty 1.1), seed 0.
